weaknesses.title: HASOBJ/GETF/SEND/DUMPOBJ ignore string *vars* as object names
weaknesses.detail: NEW S n works (n='api' creates api) but HASOBJ n → 0; HASOBJ api → 1. Agents need EQS dispatch to literals. String *literals* work for HASOBJ/DUMPOBJ.
weaknesses.repro: LET n='api'; NEW S n 1; HASOBJ n → 0; HASOBJ api → 1

weaknesses.title: GETF OR string *variable* default still strlen-coerces
weaknesses.detail: GETF o f OR DEF_DEFAULT with DEF_DEFAULT='none' → LAST=4. Literal OR "none" works. Partial fix only for formals/SETF.
weaknesses.repro: LET d='none'; GETF o ghost OR d → 4

weaknesses.title: Objects still process-local; dump rehydrate is agent glue
weaknesses.detail: No built-in object store; DUMPOBJ→WRITE→READ→LOOKUP→NEW each process.
weaknesses.repro: open run1; without dump plate has run2 miss
